name: Password
description: Password entry in Input's field anatomy, with a reveal toggle, an optional strength meter and live requirements.

props.name: autocomplete
props.description: The control's autocomplete hint. Use new-password on sign-up and reset forms so password managers offer to generate one.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label, linked to the control.

props.name: hint
props.description: Help text under the box, linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation message. Marks the field invalid and is linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid without a message. Emitted as data-invalid.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the control and the reveal button.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Makes the control read-only. It stays focusable.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field required and shows the required mark.
props.a11y: Sets required (and so aria-required) on the control.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text. Never a replacement for the label.

props.name: value
props.description: The value. Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value of an uncontrolled password.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon name before the value, such as lock, resolved through the icon registry. A slot or node overrides it.

props.name: strengthMeter
props.description: Shows the four-segment strength meter and its label (Weak, Fair, Good, Strong) under the box.

props.name: requirements
props.description: Rules shown under the box and checked as people type: [{ label, pattern }], where pattern is a regular expression source the value must match, such as .{12,} or \d.

props.name: revealLabel
props.description: The reveal button's accessible name. It stays the same; aria-pressed carries the state. Livewire translates the default.

props.name: labels
props.description: Built-in text for the strength meter and the requirement states. Keys you leave out keep their defaults; Livewire translates them.

props.name: errorField
props.description: The validation key to read from $errors. Defaults to the wire:model name.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { box: '…', reveal: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The field: label, box, meter, requirements, hint and error.

parts.name: label
parts.description: The visible label, for the control.

parts.name: required
parts.description: The required mark inside the label. Hidden from screen readers; the control is required.

parts.name: box
parts.description: The bordered box around the icon, the control and the reveal button.

parts.name: control
parts.description: The native input, type password or text while revealed. Attributes other than class land here.

parts.name: reveal
parts.description: The icon-only toggle that shows and hides the value, with aria-pressed.

parts.name: strength
parts.description: The decorative four-segment meter (aria-hidden). Emits data-level 0 to 4.

parts.name: strengthLabel
parts.description: Strength and the level name, which a polite live region announces.

parts.name: requirement
parts.description: One requirement, with a check or cross and its state for screen readers. Emits data-met.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the control, then to the reveal button.
On the reveal button: shows or hides the value.

requirements: The label is always visible and linked with for/id; a placeholder never replaces it.
The reveal button keeps one name (Show password) and toggles aria-pressed, so the state is announced without a changing label.
The meter is aria-hidden; the level name (Weak, Fair, Good, Strong) is text in a polite live region, never color alone.
Each requirement says whether it is met in text for screen readers, not only with the icon.
Hint, requirements and error are linked to the control with aria-describedby.
Class goes to the root; every other attribute (wire:model, name) goes to the control.
Visible focus ring on the box while the control has :focus-visible, and on the reveal button.

parts.hint: Use a password you don't use elsewhere.
